title: Market entry management for pharmaceutical manufacturers | Nazryx
description: Launch into frontier markets with the registrations in your name. Nazryx registers your products, appoints the importer, reaches the doctors and bids in state rounds. Paid on results.

sections.title: Launch into new markets.
sections.accent: Keep the registrations in your name.
sections.lede: Entering a frontier market is a sequence of decisions: which products, which market, which route, which partners. We make them with you, from evidence, and then run the launch on the ground.

sections.title: Most launches are decided
sections.lede: Get the order right and the market opens. Get it wrong and you lose a year and a dossier.

items.title: Choose on evidence
items.text: Which products have room, and which markets will pay, is already written in the register, the shelf and the state buyer.

items.title: Sequence the route
items.text: National or regional, which market first, which products in which wave. The order decides the timeline.

items.title: Own the market
